#!/bin/sh
# gamedash-managed Conan Exiles server — generated by provision().
# Settings: <ROOT>/installs/conan/gamedash-servers/test/Saved/Config/WindowsServer/ServerSettings.ini (and Engine.ini, Game.ini)
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
# keep the admin + admin-console passwords in step with the ones set in GameDash
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/conan/gamedash-servers/test/Saved/Config/WindowsServer" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import re, sys
d, admin = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
for name, key in (("ServerSettings.ini", "AdminPassword"), ("Game.ini", "RconPassword")):
    p = d + "/" + name
    t = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
    t = re.sub(r"(?m)^%s=.*$" % key, lambda m: key + "=" + admin, t)
    open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(t)
SYNC
export WINEPREFIX="<ROOT>/home/.wine-gd-conan-test"
export WINEDEBUG=-all
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="mscoree,mshtml="   # no Mono/Gecko install prompts (headless)
# Run headless: Wine would otherwise open a console window on the desktop
# session (unsetting DISPLAY alone isn't enough — it falls back to Wayland).
unset DISPLAY
export WAYLAND_DISPLAY=wayland-none
cd "<ROOT>/installs/conan/ConanSandbox/Binaries/Win64" || exit 1
exec wine ./ConanSandboxServer-Win64-Shipping.exe -log -userdir="Z:<WINROOT>\\installs\\conan\\gamedash-servers\\test\\" \
    -Port=7790 -QueryPort=27080 -MaxPlayers=10 \
    -ServerName="Test World" -ServerPassword="$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD"
